quest.title: Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame
quest.description: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame, the most important competition in Natlan, is about to begin. Meet up with Kachina and the gang before things start.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x1225, Mora x53900, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

chapter.title: Flowers Resplendent on the Sun-Scorched Sojourn

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kachina!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two! I just finished training with Mualani. What's up?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, you worked so hard to introduce us to Natlan, we wanted to return the favor!

choices.text: Thought I could share some experience with you.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Wow, you guys are exactly like Kachina described. No wonder she's already your biggest fan.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Guess I should make myself scarce, though. Kachina was the one who helped you out all day, so I don't want to intrude on your secret teachings.

choices.text: It's just a simple piece of advice, actually.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Huh? What do you mean?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Observation is also key.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Observation...

choices.text: Study your opponent. Master their habits.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! The person who hits the hardest isn't always the one who wins!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Oh, I... I think I get it...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: You're saying... fight smarter not harder. Having the strength to win is just as important as knowing the right strategy.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Attagirl, Kachina. Exploit your opponent's weaknesses while maximizing your own strengths, and you're sure to find opportunities to turn the tides in your favor!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: You're right. I just need to focus. When I get nervous, I forget to assess the situation, and end up rushing in without a plan...

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Mind sticking around a little longer, Mualani? I want to try out some new moves!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Sure!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Thanks for taking the time to teach me, you two. I won't let you down!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just give it your best shot!

choices.text: Let wisdom become another weapon in your arsenal.
A battle is more than just a contest of strength.
I want to help you do the best you can.

talks.objective: Meet up with Kachina and the others

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}! Morning, Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Looks like everyone's here right on time, hehe. Good to see that no one overslept!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Says the one who only made it because I was there to get you!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Ajaw, not so loud. You're gonna give me a headache...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Well, if you don't do well today, we know who to blame, now don't we?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: See how your friends talk to me, Kinich? I help you wake them up, make sure everyone's on time, and do I get a "thank you, Ajaw"? No! I get told off!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Mualani's right, though.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: ...*sigh* Hopeless, every last one of you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, moving on... How did you sleep last night, Kachina?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I had some nerves at first, but my bed was great — I fell asleep the minute my head hit the pillow.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's good to hear! Maybe you handle stress better than you know!

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: The competition's about to start. Did everyone eat something?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: A little. Didn't wanna overdo it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, we were so busy focusing on the tournament, we forgot to buy something!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I thought that might happen. Here, I brought you some.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: No thanks necessary! I'll treat you to something even better once—

dialogues.speaker: Tonina
dialogues.text: Attention, everyone. The tournament is about to begin. All contestants proceed to the venue. I repeat, all contestants proceed to the venue.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Well, I'd say more, but that's our cue.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: The opening ceremony is what kicks everything off... You should be able to see Kachina and me from the stands. We're counting on you to cheer us on!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Don't you worry! Paimon's gonna cheer so loud, you'll hear it across the stadium!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Thanks, you two. I'll be sure to keep an ear out.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Well, we should get going. See you later!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, bye-bye!

dialogues.speaker: Lamanai
dialogues.text: Attention, everyone. The tournament is about to begin. All spectators, please take your seats. I repeat, all spectators, please take your seats.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, that's our cue!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, we've definitely never witnessed a competition of this scale before! Let's go in once you're ready.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Enter the stands)

dialogues.speaker: Xpuhil
dialogues.text: Our team captain talked a big game before the match, and well... Was that a quick knockout, or what?

dialogues.speaker: Xpuhil
dialogues.text: Should keep a better lookout next time I sign up...

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: The Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame is a competition with a long, storied history. Countless hopefuls have gathered here today, each vying for the same prize — the right to serve their homeland in the Night Warden Wars.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Before we begin, allow me to remind everyone of the rules. Today's tournament begins with the team stage, before advancing into individual competition.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Each team will board a hot-air balloon, which will land at a random location.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Contestants must search for Fire Towers within the contest grounds, accumulate Contending Fire through combat, and bring a sufficient amount back to the Stadium.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Defeat in combat, departure from the contest grounds, and running out of time all lead to elimination! Only the strongest teams will be able to withstand the onslaught of battle and return to the arena, blazing Fire in hand.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Only those who emerge triumphant in the team stage earn the right to take part in the individual battles. The outcome of these one-on-one matches not only affects the contestants' individual scores but also determines their next opponent.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: After many rounds of battle, the contestants with the top five rankings will get the chance to take part in the Night Warden Wars!

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Now, let us welcome our Archon as she delivers the opening address!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Skill, strategy, fortune, form... Many factors influence strength, but victory never lies.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: The Pilgrimage is not merely a trial to determine the strongest among us, but also a stage upon which to showcase your individual growth.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Today marks the beginning of yet another legendary saga — one written in the triumphs of the victors! So, without further ado... Let the games begin!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, that's the Pyro Archon!? Is it just Paimon, or does she seem kinda intimidating...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kachina said she was "friendly and welcoming," but, uh... how did she come to that conclusion?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Didn't Kachina say she was just an ordinary person before becoming the Archon? Sure doesn't seem like it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She doesn't seem ordinary at all... Ooh, look, it's Kachina and the others!

response.speaker: Balam
response.text: Well, folks, it's clear the contestants are already raring to go! The teams will now board their hot-air balloons and make their way to the competition grounds.

response.speaker: Crowd
response.text: Chasca! Chasca!

response.speaker: Zacatula
response.text: Go, Chasca! You can do it!

response.speaker: Teayo
response.text: Kick their butts, Itzna!

response.speaker: Sausa
response.text: Go, Mualani! Go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You can do it, Kachina!

response.speaker: Balam
response.text: And the crowd goes wiiild! The hot-air balloons are about to ascend — contestants, prepare yourselves to take flight!

response.speaker: Balam
response.text: Remember the rules! The balloons will take you to random locations, and your battle starts the moment you land. Best your competition, collect Sacred Fire, and bring it back to the Stadium.

response.speaker: Balam
response.text: Good luck, everyone!

choices.text: I want to talk to her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, but it would be kinda rude to bother her during the Pilgrimage, don't you think?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We should wait for a better time... Ooh, look! It's Kachina and the others!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Guess this is where we're starting.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Let me see... Seems pretty quiet around here. Looks like we get to ease ourselves into combat today.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Let's head that way. We don't need to worry about avoiding other teams. Anyone that crosses our path can kiss their chances goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Okay. I'll follow your lead.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Just remember — don't hesitate. The team matches are all about keeping the energy up, so let's do it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There's something I need to do first...)

talks.objective: Return to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have faith in yourself, Kachina — and don't get too tense!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Have faith in yourself, Kachina — and don't get too tense!

dialogues.speaker: Tonina
dialogues.text: Congratulations, Mualani! Congratulations, Kachina! You've successfully cleared the team stage!

dialogues.speaker: Mersa
dialogues.text: Amazing! Congratulations!

dialogues.speaker: Taenga
dialogues.text: Congratulations!

dialogues.speaker: Sausa
dialogues.text: Keep it up, Mualani!

dialogues.speaker: Zacatula
dialogues.text: Kachina! Mualani!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kachina! Mualani!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Kachina! Mualani!

dialogues.speaker: Lamanai
dialogues.text: You two can take a short break while the team stage comes to a close. We'll draw names to determine the individual match-ups in a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Lamanai
dialogues.text: After that, we'll proceed to the next stage of the competition. I wish you both the best.

dialogues.speaker: Tonina
dialogues.text: You two are assigned to different lounge areas. If you'll follow me, please, Kachina.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Solo battles next, and I was three wins short last time. I've got to do better.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Phew... Just calm down, Kachina. You're in good form. You can do this...

dialogues.speaker: Tonina
dialogues.text: Hold it right there. This is the contestants' lounge. Unauthorized access is prohibited.

dialogues.speaker: Tepexpan
dialogues.text: We're contestants, too! Let us through!

dialogues.speaker: Tonina
dialogues.text: According to my list, you're not among the individual match contenders, nor are you related to any of the remaining candidates.

dialogues.speaker: Tepexpan
dialogues.text: Well, we'd still be candidates if it was just based on strength! We only lost because two other contestants snuck up on us like cowards! If you could just go contact the referee, we'll wait right here for you to—

dialogues.speaker: Tamuin
dialogues.text: Ah...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Wait, you two are...

dialogues.speaker: Tepexpan
dialogues.text: Well, look who we have here. Remember us? Your little trick got us disqualified!

dialogues.speaker: Tamuin
dialogues.text: Since we've crossed paths again, let's settle this once and for all. We'll see who truly deserves to advance to the next stage... Fight us.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Right now?

dialogues.speaker: Tonina
dialogues.text: Don't mind him, Kachina. Tournament rules place you under no obligation to honor that request — a loss is a loss, and that's final.

dialogues.speaker: Tonina
dialogues.text: You! Don't just stand there! Get security over here, now!

dialogues.speaker: Tepexpan
dialogues.text: Forget the rules! Isn't the Pilgrimage about picking the strongest warriors? She just happened to catch us off-guard. It was all luck!

dialogues.speaker: Tamuin
dialogues.text: Exactly. Now's our chance to duke it out fair and square—

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Kachina!

response.speaker: Tepexpan
response.text: Who are you?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! Paimon! What are you doing here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We just came to have a chat, and then all of a sudden, these guys were threatening you!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmph. You're not bullying Kachina on our watch!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Th—Thanks, you guys.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I don't know your names... But, if you really want to face me, I'll allow it.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: It has to wait until after the tournament, though! I need to focus on the upcoming matches. I don't want to let my parents down, or any of the friends who helped me get this far.

response.speaker: Tonina
response.text: That's enough, you two. "Being caught off-guard" is not an excuse. You think you can cry foul play when you face the Abyss?

response.speaker: Tonina
response.text: If this behavior persists, you may find yourselves barred from future competition.

response.speaker: Tamuin
response.text: Tch... Whatever. Let's go.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are you alright? You're not hurt anywhere, are you?

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: No, thanks to you. To be honest, I totally blanked out just now. I had no idea what to do.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Right! I—I'll show them what I'm made of!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That sounds more like it! You can do it!

response.speaker: Lamanai
response.text: I heard there was trouble... Has the situation been resolved?

response.speaker: Tonina
response.text: Yes. It was nothing out of the ordinary — a couple of sore losers coming to stir up trouble with the contestants.

response.speaker: Lamanai
response.text: *sigh* Some people are so obsessed with glory, they can't even bear the idea of failure.

response.speaker: Lamanai
response.text: I hope you don't let them get to you, Kachina, because you'll need to get ready. Your match is up soon.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: That came up quick... Alright, I'm coming!

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Hehe, w—well, guess I'm off!

dialogues.speaker: Nkunga
dialogues.text: You must be Kachina?

dialogues.speaker: Nkunga
dialogues.text: You know, people told me I got lucky in the draw, but I beg to differ. There are no coincidences in the arena. If you're standing here, it means you're strong, no matter what anyone says.

dialogues.speaker: Nkunga
dialogues.text: So, I'm looking forward to seeing what you're made of. The team stage ended before I had my fill of battle. I hope you don't disappoint.

dialogues.speaker: Nkunga
dialogues.text: Well, anything you want to say in return?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I—I won't lose to you, not when so many people are supporting me, and cheering for me, and I—

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I really want to earn a spot in the Night Warden Wars!

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Alright, our contestants have each said their piece. To your places, everyone. Aaand... Begin!

dialogues.speaker: Lamanai
dialogues.text: We issued a warning to those two troublemakers. Try not to let them get to you.

dialogues.speaker: Lamanai
dialogues.text: We get people like that every year. The Pilgrimage symbolizes glory, and some people can't accept missing out on the chance to claim it.

dialogues.speaker: Nkunga
dialogues.text: *cough* I actually lost... Hah, knew I had an eye for the good ones. Guess that means I was right about you all along...

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Congratulations to Kachina for taking the win! Let's give her a round of applause, everyone! Now, diving into the other match-ups...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's one down, woohoo!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The rounds continue. Kachina scores some wins and suffers some losses. Her ranking stays in the middle of the pack.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The individual match-ups reach the halfway mark. It's Kachina's turn to take the field again.

dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: Where'd you come from, kid? Think you've got what it takes to go to war?

dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: Hate to break it to you, but it won't be easy to get through me.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: You don't recognize me? Hah, figures. Our generation's been in decline ever since Atea and the others retired from the frontlines.

dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: Either way, once we face off, you won't forget my name any time soon. Let's do this!

dialogues.speaker: Tournament Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: (The competition announcement board. The upcoming match schedule and contestant scores are displayed here.)

dialogues.speaker: Tournament Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: (The final round is about to begin...)

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Mualani...

dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: Gotta hand it to you, kid, you really impressed me. I take back what I said before our match.

dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: You've got what it takes, Kachina. Youngsters like you? You'll forge your own miracles.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: And it's Kachina for the win! We'll now head into a short break as our contestants prepare for the final round of competition!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Thanks for cheering me on, you two.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You were great out there! You faced a lot of impressive competitors, but they never stood a chance!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I don't think I did too shabby, either. I've never gotten this many points before...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Ready for the last round, Kachina?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Mualani!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I got permission to come see you before the last round starts. Based on your score, it looks like you'll make it to the Night Warden Wars if you win your next match.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: But, uh, your final opponent... It's me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How unfortunate...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Yeah, I just found out myself. We're really close in the rankings, so... Only the winner gets to move forward.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: But, I... I wanted to fight alongside you.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I did, too, but it is what it is. People with similar scores tend to get matched against each other.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: But, we just have to get past it! War is cruel, and the Abyss certainly isn't going to go easy on us. Only Natlan's strongest deserve to stand against them.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: So, I'm going to give this battle my all, Kachina, and I hope you do the same.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: To hand victory to your opponent is to take pity on them. But, no one's asking for pity, here, yeah? So, you ready?

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I—I'll do my best!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Attagirl.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, if one of you has to lose... Who should we cheer for, then?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hahaha, you mean one of us is destined to win! It's something worth celebrating either way!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I'll be happy no matter who wins, and I know you feel the same way, Kachina. So don't overthink it — let's just have ourselves a good match.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon — I'll see you after the match. Kachina — I'll see you on the field.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: I've been training so long for this, and Mualani's helped so much. I'm going to show her that it didn't go to waste.

response.speaker: Kachina
response.text: Thanks for believing in me. I'll... try believing in myself this time, too.

talks.objective: Take part in the award ceremony

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: And with that, the winners of this Pilgrimage have been decided!

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Put your hands together for our victors as we welcome them to the stage—

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: With her sixth consecutive win... Chasca of the Flower-Feather Clan!

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: She managed to turn the tides all by herself... Iansan of the Collective of Plenty!

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: With an explosive comeback ten years in the making... Kaiulani of the People of the Springs!

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: A seasoned and renowned warrior... Kibangu of the Scions of the Canopy.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Last but not least... Finally living up to her true potential... Kachina of the Children of Echoes!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woo! Over here, Kachina!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I... I made it...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Feels like a dream.

dialogues.speaker: Chasca
dialogues.text: This is no dream. Your strength is what got you here.

dialogues.speaker: Iansan
dialogues.text: We'll be going to war together. It's an honor to fight alongside you, Kachina.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: No matter how many Pilgrimages I witness, I'm always overwhelmed with pride in this moment.

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Pride for you, my brave warriors. You give me faith that our innumerable sacrifices are not in vain, that the future of Natlan shall burn with the brilliance of a blazing fire!

dialogues.speaker: Mavuika
dialogues.text: Brave warriors, the following is an order, and also a personal request — go forth and crush the Abyss. Seize victory and glory for Natlan!

dialogues.speaker: Crowd
dialogues.text: As you command!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: A—As you command!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As the crowd erupts in cheers, the Pilgrimage draws to a close.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon! There you are!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: I wanted to thank you for supporting Kachina back there. She really has grown into a formidable competitor. She deserved that win.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Not that it feels good to lose, but I'm happy for her... *sigh* Definitely bittersweet, though.

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Hey, wanna go for a walk? Kachina and the others will be busy fighting the Abyss, so why don't I show you around Natlan for a while?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Sure. What do you say, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, something on your mind?

choices.text: I'm a little worried about Kachina.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Listen, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't worried. But, she's got experienced, powerful companions to take the lead. I'm sure they'll be fine.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Glory always comes with a risk. If victory was assured, no one would take pride in it.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: She's not one to fall so easily. She bears the Ancient Name, "Utha{RUBY#[D]Resilience}biti," after all. We just need to hold the fort while they're gone...

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Come to think of it, you've never visited my tribe, have you? Come on, I'll take you.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: The People of the Springs live alongside the Koholasaurs. Our tribe is an ideal spot for some R & R! I'll take you to all the best spots. You'll love it!

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: ...Looks like you beat me to it.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Kinich?

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: I was planning on inviting you to visit the Scions of the Canopy. Most of the Adventurers that belong to the Guild come from my tribe, so I figured you might be interested.

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Hey, first come, first served. You snooze you lose, Kinich.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: #Yeah, yeah. You were first. Still, {NICKNAME}, Paimon, feel free to stop by if you ever have time. You're always welcome.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Thanks for inviting us!

response.speaker: Mualani
response.text: Alright! Let's pack up and head out!

choices.text: This is her first time fighting in the Night Warden Wars, right?

talks.objective: Take part in the award ceremony

dialogues.speaker: Tonina
dialogues.text: A competition is no place for regrets. Leave it all on the field. I have faith in you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So full... *yawn* and so sleepy... We should get a good night's sleep before the competition tomorrow!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's still a little worried about Kachina, though. Maybe we can help her out with her training?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She did say she wanted to learn from us... Not that Paimon's gonna be doing much of the teaching...

dialogues.speaker: Lamanai
dialogues.text: Entering the Stadium of the Sacred Flame? You won't be able to leave the arena once the tournament begins.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cheerleaders One and Two are here for you, no matter what!

dialogues.speaker: Kibangu
dialogues.text: Hear me out, you two. There's no Fire Tower around here, so there's no need for us to fight it out.

dialogues.speaker: Kibangu
dialogues.text: We can see who comes out on top the next time we run into each other. But, for now, I say we focus on preserving our strength. What do you think?

dialogues.speaker: Tournament Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: (The competition announcement board. The upcoming match schedule and contestant scores are displayed here.)

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: My next opponent is new to the Pilgrimage... But, they still seem really strong.

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Is... Is it really possible for me to come out on top?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Cheerleaders One and Two are here for you, no matter what!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: I'm not keeping you up, am I? You sure you'll be fine tomorrow?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm bursting with energy. Couldn't sleep if I wanted to!

dialogues.speaker: Tonina
dialogues.text: I wonder who's gonna win this time. Who do you think's the favorite?

dialogues.speaker: Lamanai
dialogues.text: That's a tough one. Anything can happen, especially in the team stage.

dialogues.speaker: Lamanai
dialogues.text: Sometimes, the favorites are forced to face each other early on. Factoring in the environment and different participant strategies... It's impossible to predict who will come out on top.

dialogues.speaker: Tonina
dialogues.text: True, true. *sigh* You think I'd have a chance in the Pilgrimage one day? I've been training every day after work.

dialogues.speaker: Lamanai
dialogues.text: It's certainly possible. I'll be rooting for you if you ever get the chance!

dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: Hey, Kaiulani. How are the preparations going?

dialogues.speaker: Kaiulani
dialogues.text: Not bad, I guess.

dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: You don't look too confident.

dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: Chin up! We're experienced warriors! We've got this in the bag!

dialogues.speaker: Kaiulani
dialogues.text: You're as energetic as ever, but I feel like I'm getting old. The last time I fought in the Night Warden Wars was how many years ago, now? Ten? It's already been so long...

dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: Ten years is nothing! We're in our prime! I don't know about you, but I'm going for gold!

dialogues.speaker: Itzna
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Itzna
dialogues.text: No surprises, here...

dialogues.speaker: Itzna
dialogues.text: No matter how many times I participate, I'm always so nervous...

dialogues.speaker: Mersa
dialogues.text: Five people are going to be selected for the Night Warden Wars this time around, but to be honest... The number makes no difference.

dialogues.speaker: Mersa
dialogues.text: Chasca's going to win. I'm sure of it!

dialogues.speaker: Sausa
dialogues.text: Seems a little early to celebrate, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Sayil
dialogues.text: You two look nervous! Let's go for a drink and kick back for a bit, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Tlaco
dialogues.text: What, now?

dialogues.speaker: Sayil
dialogues.text: Now's the perfect time! Knock back a few drinks, and you'll loosen right up. Otherwise, your nerves will keep you up all night. Trust me — I'm an experienced competitor.

dialogues.speaker: Cempoa
dialogues.text: And, that's why you're team captain! Great idea!

dialogues.speaker: Becan
dialogues.text: Looks like we'll be commentating together this time around. Pleasure to meet you.

dialogues.speaker: Labna
dialogues.text: The pleasure's all mine. Just remember to be liberal with the sunscreen tomorrow — the sunlight is intense up in the hot-air balloon.

dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: How are the preparations going?

dialogues.speaker: Becan
dialogues.text: Pleasure to meet you.

dialogues.speaker: Tonina
dialogues.text: Who do you think's the favorite?

dialogues.speaker: Itzna
dialogues.text: So nervous...

dialogues.speaker: Sayil
dialogues.text: Let's go for a drink!

dialogues.speaker: Lakamha
dialogues.text: Ugh, that attack came out of nowhere... Should've paid more attention to my surroundings...

dialogues.speaker: Baak
dialogues.text: Gimme a moment to myself, would you...

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: This mountain is huge. Is the next Tower really all the way up there?

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: It's going to take forever to make it to the top...

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Just leave it to me! I'll get us up there!

dialogues.speaker: Mualani
dialogues.text: Phew, we made it! Great work, Kachina!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: Hehe, glad I could help.

dialogues.speaker: Tournament Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: Migue! Migue!!

dialogues.speaker: Liliuo
dialogues.text: Hear that? The exhilarating cheers of the crowd... That's why I'm here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, Kachina! You can do it!

dialogues.speaker: Kachina
dialogues.text: That was close...
